name: 92603 · Irvine, CA
findings: ZIP 92603 (Irvine) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92603 (Irvine) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92603 (Irvine) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
